# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 15 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Joseph Prays for Aseneth; She Is Blessed

---

**15:1** And Joseph saw Aseneth's grief and was moved with compassion toward her and said: 'The Lord will make you live, for you have fled to him for refuge.' And he rose up from his seat and went to Pentephres and said: 'Your daughter Aseneth came to me just now and she loves me. I do not know from where she came, but I love her and wish to take her as my wife. Tell me, if you are willing.'

**15:2** And Pentephres and his wife rejoiced greatly and said: 'The Lord God Most High blessed you, Joseph, and so he will give our daughter Aseneth to you as a wife.'

**15:3** And they brought Aseneth and set her before Joseph, and Pentephres took the right hand of Aseneth and placed it in the right hand of Joseph.

**15:4** And Joseph said: 'Lord God of my father Israel, the Most High and the Mighty One, who made everything alive and called the darkness to the light and the error to the truth and death to life — you yourself, Lord, bless this virgin and renew her by your Spirit, and may she eat the bread of your life and drink the cup of your blessing.'

**15:5** And Pentephres said: 'Carry Aseneth in and put on her wedding garments, and bring her in to Joseph.' And they did so.

**15:6** And Pentephres brought them both together, and Joseph took Aseneth's right hand, and they sat down at the table and feasted.

**15:7** And after the feast Pentephres said to Joseph: 'Let all the men go out of here.' And all the men went out, and he was left alone with Aseneth and her seven virgins.

**15:8** And Pentephres and his wife brought Joseph and Aseneth together and blessed them before all the guests, and there was joy in the house of Pentephres.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
